RESULT.HEADING: Result
RESULT.EMPTY: Scan a site or pick one from the history to see its result here.
RESULT.TITLE: Results for {{host}}
RESULT.CACHED: Saved result from the last 15 minutes; the site was not fetched again.
RESULT.DETAILS: What it is and what was received
RESULT.NO_VALUE: The site does not send this header.

REASON.NOT_HTTPS: The site is served without HTTPS, so HSTS has no effect.
REASON.REPORT_ONLY: Report-Only mode: it reports, but blocks nothing.
REASON.UNSAFE_DIRECTIVE: Allows 'unsafe-eval', or 'unsafe-inline' for scripts with no nonce or hash to neutralise it: an injected script would run.
REASON.NO_SCRIPT_POLICY: Does not restrict scripts: it has neither script-src nor default-src, so it does not protect against XSS.
REASON.WILDCARD_SOURCE: Allows scripts from any origin (*, https:, http: or data:), an attacker’s included.
REASON.OBJECT_SRC_OPEN: Leaves plugins (<object>, <embed>) unrestricted. object-src 'none' is recommended.
REASON.INVALID_VALUE: Has a value browsers do not recognise.
REASON.UNSAFE_VALUE: Has a value that leaves the protection switched off.
REASON.FRAME_ANCESTORS: Covered by the CSP's frame-ancestors directive.
REASON.TECH_DISCLOSED: Reveals the technology the site is built with.

ABOUT.HSTS: Makes the browser always use HTTPS for this domain, even when someone types http://.
ABOUT.CSP: Lists which origins may load scripts, styles and images. The main defence against XSS.
ABOUT.CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS: With 'nosniff', the browser does not guess a file's type, so it never runs as a script something that is not one.
ABOUT.FRAME_OPTIONS: Stops another site from putting this one in an iframe to trick users into clicks (clickjacking).
ABOUT.REFERRER_POLICY: Controls how much of the current URL is sent to other sites when following a link.
ABOUT.PERMISSIONS_POLICY: Turns off browser features the site does not use, such as camera, microphone or location.
ABOUT.COOP: Isolates the window from pages it opens or that open it, which blocks cross-tab attacks.
ABOUT.CORP: Says which other sites may load this site's resources.
ABOUT.SERVER_DISCLOSURE: A version number in the Server header tells an attacker which vulnerabilities to try.
ABOUT.POWERED_BY_DISCLOSURE: X-Powered-By advertises the server's framework or language and gives the visitor nothing.
